title: SWAP5-Groundwater Coupling Temporal Error Budget, Window Convergence and Predictor-Corrector Qualification Closeout

F_GC06_relationship.head: cc28f2ceabd583484c00a3fd36373dc7ab1f202e
F_GC06_relationship.statement: F-GC07 qualifies only temporal/coupling error and does not instantiate H_app or alter F-GC06.

test_domain.reference: PC4 at DeltaT=1/128 day; numerical reference, not physical truth

characterization.predictor_empirical_order: approximately first order in both test classes

temporal_estimators.scope: test-class numerical characterization only; no universal error coefficient

adaptation_logic.shrink: when predictor-corrector correction grows, residual contraction degrades, extra correction is required, or a qualified temporal allocation is exceeded
adaptation_logic.grow: only after sustained small contracting corrections with the independent SWAP temporal indicator acceptable; growth must be bounded and reversible

architecture_invariants.7: PASS transactional predictor/corrector trials from same committed T0; rejected trials not booked
architecture_invariants.8: PASS within harness scope; repeated physical start is committed T0, no new production warm-start claim
architecture_invariants.9: PASS generic non-midnight time and fractional windows
architecture_invariants.10: PASS flexible coupling windows across five DeltaT values
architecture_invariants.11: PASS within research scope; predictor/corrector, residual, rollback semantics and cost explicit
architecture_invariants.12: PASS controlled interface: q_SWAP=-q_GW and head mismatch studied; no MODFLOW admission
architecture_invariants.14: PASS at contract level; tangent carrier first-class, end-to-end composition held
architecture_invariants.15: PASS characterized normal path is predictor plus one corrector; PC4 is research reference only
architecture_invariants.23: PASS physics unchanged and numerical policy separate
architecture_invariants.26: PASS harness records solver cost, residual and mass diagnostics
architecture_invariants.29: PASS no silent midnight, daily, file or MODFLOW dependency

hard_nonclaims: no numeric application H_app or universal A_temporal
no claim PC1 is second order
no claim numerical reference is physical truth

downstream.requires: independent H_app, defensible temporal allocation, and transfer qualification from GC07 test-class evidence to the application class
downstream.possible_form: H_budget = A_temporal * H_app or a better source-bound equivalent

exact_head_self_verification: The commit introducing this closeout must pass the full F-GC07 workflow; that successful run is the final branch authority and no additional production admission is implied.
